decisive_items: compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery
Doppler ultrasonography of the left lower extremity demonstrated extensive deep vein thrombosis
response.rationale: May-Thurner syndrome is the more specific diagnosis given the compression of the left common iliac vein by the overlying right common iliac artery, which is a characteristic finding of this condition. While deep vein thrombosis is present, it is a consequence of the underlying May-Thurner syndrome.

rejected.why: less specific diagnosis compared to May-Thurner syndrome
